plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/plugin_info/con.Langue dans laquelle l'IRM rédige ses bu: Language in which RMI writes its bulletins and warnings. Defaults to Jeedom's, which is right in almost every case; this setting mainly helps bilingual installations.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/plugin_info/con.Secondes avant d'abandonner un appel à l: Seconds before giving up on a call to RMI. Ten is usually enough; raise it on a slow connection, but stay under a minute: the cron that refreshes municipalities is shared with the other plugins.

plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Aucune commune pour le moment. Pour déma: No municipality yet. To get started:
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Balises disponibles : #commune#, #niveau: Available tags: #commune#, #niveau#, #type#, #texte#, #debut#, #fin#. Other warnings in force are appended automatically - an orange thunderstorm with a yellow wind warning is not the same evening as a thunderstorm alone.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Balises, dans le titre comme dans le mes: Tags, in the title as in the message: #min#, #max#, #conditions#, #conseils# (advice), #bulletin# (RMI's written bulletin), #commune#, #vent# (wind, km/h), #pluie# (chance of rain, %). A value RMI no longer provides - the minimum, in the afternoon - is replaced by nothing.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Chaque jour à l'heure choisie, un messag: Every day at the chosen time, a short message: the day's minimum, maximum and advice - "12°C - 21°C | Take an umbrella". It is sent only once a day, even though the plugin runs every ten minutes.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Cliquez sur « Ajouter une commune » et d: Click "Add a municipality" and give it a name, for example "Home".
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Enregistrez : les commandes sont créées: Save: the commands are created and the weather is read straight away.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Facultatif. Une condition au format des: Optional. A condition in scenario syntax, checked at sending time: for instance "someone is at home". When false, the bulletin is skipped for the day. When it cannot be computed - deleted command, typo - it is not sent either, and the log says so: better a missed bulletin than a phone woken up on holiday.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.L'IRM publie ses avertissements jusqu'à: RMI publishes warnings up to twelve hours ahead: the second option gives you time to bring in the garden furniture, at the cost of one more message per episode.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.L'orange par défaut. En Belgique le jaun: Orange by default. In Belgium, yellow fires for fog or sixty km/h winds, several times a month: a notification that rings too often ends up being switched off, and is no longer there on the day it matters.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Le nom de la commune, pas le code postal: The name of the municipality, not the postal code.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Le plugin passe toutes les dix minutes :: The plugin runs every ten minutes: 6:35 is sent at 6:40. If Jeedom was stopped at that time, the bulletin is still sent within the following two hours, never later - advice to take a jacket is useless at noon.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Les avertissements sont publiés à l'avan: Warnings are published ahead of time: an announced warning is not yet in force. Only those marked "in force" set the "Warning active" command to 1.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Les données proviennent de l'Institut Ro: Data comes from the Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium. This plugin is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by RMI.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Les données proviennent de l\\'Institut: Data comes from the Royal Meteorological Institute of Belgium. This plugin is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by RMI.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Les mêmes actions que pour les vigilance: The same kind of actions as for warnings: notification, text-to-speech, TV display. "Test" sends today's real bulletin right away, ignoring the condition, and tells what the condition is worth right now. "In parallel" runs each action separately, so that a slow action does not delay the other municipalities - at the cost of no longer knowing whether it succeeded.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Tapez les premières lettres de la commun: Type the first letters of the municipality, then pick it from the list. All 565 Belgian municipalities ship with the plugin: you can search in French as well as in Dutch.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Toute commande d'action de Jeedom : une: Any Jeedom action command: a notification, text-to-speech, a scenario, a lamp. The "Test" button sends a trial message right away - the only way to check your setup without waiting for the next storm.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Une même vigilance n'est annoncée qu'une: The same warning is announced only once, even if it lasts six hours and the plugin re-reads it every ten minutes. You are notified again only if it gets worse, or if a new phenomenon appears.
plugins/meteobelgiqueirm/desktop/php/met.Être prévenu en cas de vigilance: Get notified on a weather warning
